explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly validates LLM judges against human evaluation on 10% of the test set using correlation analysis and inter-annotator agreement comparison

prompts.notes: Full evaluation rubric and scoring criteria shown in system prompt for GPT-4o mini used as judge

inter_annotator_agreement.interpretation: showing that the LLM aligns with human consensus nearly as well as humans agree among themselves

guidelines.notes: Human verification process for question-answer pairs described with specific criteria per skill type (global appearance, character actions, etc.)

sample_size.notes: Validation conducted on 10% of the test set (20% of total benchmark was human verified, with 10% test split)

quantitative_scores.notes: Between LLM scores and averaged human ratings
Confirming that the LLM's ranking of outputs closely matches human preferences

validation_results.summary_finding: LLM judge exhibits near-human-level alignment with Pearson correlation of 0.92 and Spearman correlation of 0.89, validating its use as a reliable proxy for human evaluation

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluates reasoning-based skills using 5-point rubric scoring from 0-10, while human verification focuses on validation of question-answer pairs
